QuestInfo.name: Shadow of Chaos
QuestInfo.0: Listen to what Do Gong has to say about Nobunaga's destination.
QuestInfo.1: Do Gong thinks that the Oda Army is headed for the Goblin Forest in the Virtuous Forest, the center of Maple World's energy. Investigate the Goblin Forest.
QuestInfo.2: Surprisingly, it wasn't Oda who colluded with the Black Wings to make the monsters go on a rampage. It was Akechi Mitsuhide, acting independently! Mitsuhide left Nobunaga to create a new faction!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,531,024\nCan proceed to the Chaos Rising quest

0.0: They must be headed for the Goblin Forest. It's a real energy sinkhole.
0.1: Investigate the Goblin Forest to discover the true intentions of these menaces. I can assure you they're up to no good.

yes.0: The goblins have dug in deep within the Virtuous Forest. The lord of the area is powerful, so you would do well to prepare yourself and move with caution.

1.0: How could Akechi Mitsuhide have orchestrated this invasion? That silver-haired devil could be more of a threat than Nobunaga...
1.1: I must send word to Momijigaoka.

default.0: You should investigate the Goblin Forest and see for yourself. It's in the Virtuous Forest.
